title: Document the original agreement’s deliverables
returnUnsaved: Return to the workflow and discard unsaved changes to the source, review or benefits?
reasonHelp: One reason is shared by the review draft and agreement qualification. Enter at least 5 characters. Individual clause explanations remain separate.
reasonReady: The shared review and qualification reason is entered.
reasonMissing: The shared review and qualification reason still needs to be entered.
editReason: Enter or edit the shared reason
documentingClause: Clause {{clause}}: complete the benefit in this draft, then return to establish its mapping. No commitment has been applied yet.

hints.saveSourceFirst: Save the source changes before starting another analysis.
hints.saveReviewFirst: Save the review draft or explicitly discard its changes before starting another analysis.
hints.sourceRequired: Save the agreement text before analyzing it.
hints.analysisRunning: An analysis is already queued or processing. Its result will appear here.
hints.analysisUnavailable: A new analysis is not available for this agreement’s current state.

blockers.title: Complete before applying
blockers.offer: Document a complete benefit in the form.
blockers.reason: Enter the shared review and qualification reason (at least 5 characters).
blockers.unresolved: Clause {{clause}}: choose its resolution in the draft.
blockers.mapping: Clause {{clause}}: choose a corresponding documented benefit.
blockers.unsupported: Clause {{clause}}: a contractual term requires manual handling.
blockers.exclusion: Clause {{clause}}: explain the out-of-scope decision (at least 5 characters).
blockers.coverage: Map each benefit in the form to a reviewed clause.
blockers.stale: Reread the source and review: their versions have changed.
blockers.review: Reread current capabilities and mappings before confirming.
blockers.more: {{count}} other issues still need attention in the clauses.

sourceConflict: Someone saved a new source version. Your text is preserved against its original version. Compare the stored text before explicitly loading the current version.
resetSource: Replace my text with the current source
reviewConflict: The review changed while you were editing. Your resolutions are preserved and cannot be applied to the new version. Explicitly load the saved review before continuing.
resetReview: Discard my changes and load the saved review
saveBeforeRun: Save the review draft or explicitly discard its changes before starting a new indexing run.
apply: Apply reviewed benefits to the agreement
formScope: This form applies the selected review with its source and versions. Document benefits and review every clause before confirming with the dossier identifier.
replaceDraft: Replace the entered benefits with the saved review draft?
localNotice: Local analysis of the stored text, without an external provider or AI model. Explicit mentions are presented for review; a person verifies benefits before applying them.

source.title: Original agreement — private source
source.name: Source title
source.help: Copy the relevant agreement text (up to {{max}} characters). A new version automatically queues local indexing. Identical content does not start another run. Content is treated as data, never as instructions.
source.save: Save and index a source version
source.editHelp: Saving a new version starts local analysis and requires reviewing the proposal linked to the previous source.

manualHelp: Manual qualification remains available in the agreement form, even when assistance is unavailable.
stale: The source or commitment changed after this run. Read current facts and start a new run before using the proposal.
failed: The run did not finish successfully. Refresh its state, start a new run if available, or complete the agreement manually.
mappingHelp: Compare located details with their source. Complete or revise benefits in the qualification form, then link each representable clause to a documented benefit. No offer is applied automatically.

attention.human_mapping_required: A person must establish the mapping.
attention.unsupported_terms: This clause may contain terms the commitment model cannot represent. Including it prevents assisted application.

dispositions.unsupported: Unrepresentable contractual term — manual handling required

unsupportedHelp: A real contractual term that cannot be represented needs manual handling. Do not exclude it to enable application. “Outside the contractual scope” only corrects a detection with no contractual meaning and requires an explanation.
applied: The business workflow qualified the agreement. Refresh the receipt to see which controls are satisfied.
separation: Indexing or saving a draft does not satisfy a control. Applying requires the owner's explicit confirmation and publishes nothing.

proposal.reviewProgress: Draft: {{resolved}} of {{total}} clauses completed. Applying still requires confirmation.
proposal.nextUnresolved: Go to the first clause to complete
proposal.noItems: No clauses found in this text. Check the source or document commitments manually; a lack of detected clauses does not mean there are no obligations.
proposal.caption: Benefits and clauses to review
proposal.counts: Publication clauses: {{publications}} · Evidence clauses: {{proofs}} · Lines to review: {{clauses}}
proposal.reviewHelp: Each row is a source clause. Quantities are not added together. “To confirm” means the text provides no unambiguous explicit value. Located details do not replace benefits validated in the form.
proposal.legacy: This result uses the previous line index. It remains available for consultation and review. Start an explicit new indexing run to obtain structured details.
proposal.noStructuredDetails: This generation has no structured details; review the excerpt.

gaps.ambiguous_context: Ambiguous, conditional or non-contractual context: values still need confirmation.
gaps.channel_ambiguous: The link to a channel remains ambiguous in this clause.
gaps.quantity_missing: No explicit publication quantity was located.
gaps.quantity_ambiguous: The number’s scope or quantity remains ambiguous.
gaps.target_missing: A person must document the destination.
gaps.target_ambiguous: Several destinations are mentioned; their mapping needs clarification.
gaps.format_missing: The benefit’s format must be documented.
gaps.format_ambiguous: The cited format does not unambiguously match a supported format.
gaps.outside_offer_model: Some terms exceed the current commercial model. They remain visible and require manual handling.

errors.forbidden: Your permissions no longer allow this assistance. Private data was cleared.
errors.unavailable: Assistance is unavailable. Retry the read or complete the agreement manually.
errors.uncertain: The command result needs verification. Current facts were read without repeating the command.
errors.stale: Facts or versions changed. Read the source and review again before continuing.
errors.timeout: The run remains pending beyond the tracking period. Refresh its state or use manual qualification.
errors.reviewInvalid: Check the review reason and mappings to documented benefits.
